# ZouIC

> ZouIC - Global open-source development board Demo aggregation platform, providing development board database, project search, technical documentation and one-stop hardware development resources.

ZouIC is an open-source hardware knowledge base: development board specifications, demo projects aggregated from CrowdSupply / Hackaday / Hackster.io, practical tutorials, and selection guides. All core content is public and free to read.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://www.zouic.com/): board database, project search, tutorials and latest articles
- [Board database](https://www.zouic.com/boards): specifications and buying guidance for ESP32, STM32, RP2040, RISC-V and NearLink boards
- [Demo projects](https://www.zouic.com/projects): hands-on project cases with frameworks, difficulty levels and source links
- [Aggregated projects](https://www.zouic.com/all-projects): projects from CrowdSupply, Hackaday and Hackster.io
- [Board selection guide](https://www.zouic.com/board-guide): how to choose your first development board
- [Documentation](https://www.zouic.com/documentation) and [NearLink docs](https://www.zouic.com/docs/nearlink)
- [Website building service](https://www.zouic.com/services/website-building): company websites from ¥3,000, GEO retainers from ¥1,500/month, free 30-minute visibility audit
- [About](https://www.zouic.com/about)

## Usage notes
- Content may be quoted or summarized with attribution and a link to the original page.
- Board specifications are compiled from vendor documentation; verify critical parameters before purchasing.
- Project listings link to their original repositories and platforms; licenses follow each project.
